title: S43 — Failure analysis: categorize all 13 hard misses by root cause
desc: For each of the 13 hard misses, determine: (1) which family? (2) segmentation OK/fail? (3) matching OK/fail? (4) lex projection helped/hurt/neutral? Build a decision tree of failure modes. This tells us exactly where to invest. Owner: scott. Priority: 1.
